Acme Robotics | Senior Backend Engineer, Staff ML Engineer | San Francisco, CA / Remote | Full-time | https://acmerobotics.com

We're building autonomous warehouse robots that are already deployed at Fortune 500 companies. Series B, 120 employees, profitable unit economics.

What we're working on:
- Fleet management system (Go, Kubernetes, gRPC)
- Real-time motion planning (C++, ROS2)
- ML pipeline for object detection (Python, PyTorch)

Who we're looking for:
- Senior Backend Engineer: 5+ years experience, strong Go or Rust, distributed systems
- Staff ML Engineer: experience shipping ML models to production, robotics a plus

We offer competitive comp ($180k-$240k + equity), full remote for most roles, and a genuine chance to work on hard problems.

Apply at https://acmerobotics.com/careers or email jobs@acmerobotics.com
